name: pocket-server
description: Turn an Android phone into a portable Node.js + Express server with a Wi-Fi file portal, packaged as a Capacitor APK.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:ui && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:lite: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleLiteDebug
scripts.apk:full: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleFullDebug
scripts.apk:lite:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleLiteRelease
scripts.apk:full:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleFullRelease

author: RyanNars
